remarks: Welcome to 5777 Indian Pointe Dr, an immaculately maintained residence in the exclusive Montaire community, being offered by the original owners of the property for the first time. This 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home offers 4,216 square feet of living space and the community’s largest floor plan. The specific location and orientation of this particular lot offers a truly unmatched, panoramic view of the Santa Susana Mountains and all of Simi Valley right from the backyard, where dazzling sunsets over the landscape are a must-see.
